name: Gitara
source:
A short, scuff and sappy visual novel about a lesbian who sometimes plays the acoustic guitar. Set in the Philippines.

[From [url=https://fourword.itch.io/gitara-guitar]Itch.io[/url]]
translation: 一部短小、略顯粗糙又煽情的視覺小說，講述一位偶爾彈奏木吉他的女同性戀者。故事發生在菲律賓。[引自[url=https://fourword.itch.io/gitara-guitar]Itch.io[/url]]
